declarations.notes: The qualitative declaration is exactly one positive zero of the canonical §6.2 realEi map, expressed with the direct predicate 0 < x ∧ realEi x = 0. The separate quantitative declaration supplies the 30-digit enclosure shown by the DLMF decimal.

Primary statement is the finite displayed prefix for the complete positive Ci and lower-case si zero families, with α=kπ and α=(k+1/2)π. The quantitative companion retains the source's next-term absolute bound and same-sign property for the displayed terms. Six13AsymptoticData and its arbitrary coefficient continuation remain explicitly auxiliary for an all-orders formulation of the source ellipsis.
